Task.title: Task
Task.description: Represents a task or business opportunity within the system.

title.description: Title of the task or business opportunity.

client.description: Name of the client associated with the task.

value.description: Estimated value of the task or business opportunity.

probability.description: Probability of success for the task (percentage).

status.description: Current status of the task (e.g., backlog, prospecting, negotiation, closing, done).

priority.description: Priority level of the task (e.g., low, medium, high).

delegateTo.description: Name of the person to whom the task is delegated.

TeamMember.title: TeamMember
TeamMember.description: Represents a team member in the system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the team member.

name.description: Full name of the team member.

email.description: Email address of the team member.

role.description: Role or position of the team member.

phone.description: Phone number of the team member.

avatarUrl.description: URL of the team member's avatar.

definition.description: Stores task data for a specific user.

params.name: userId
params.description: The ID of the user who owns these tasks.

definition.description: Stores team member data for a specific user.

params.name: userId
params.description: The ID of the user who owns this team.

params.name: memberId
params.description: Unique identifier for the team member.
